assets.generationMethod: OpenAI built-in image generation, then nearest-neighbor resize to the required 300x225 size
assets.prompt: True first-person 16-bit pixel-art view inside a professional sports club consultation room in daytime. The player's gender-neutral hands rest beside an unsigned contract proposal; one adult scout sits across the desk; a smartphone shows only a non-readable notification icon for a separate former-school coach proposal. Use a crisp grid-aligned limited muted cream, ochre, brown, olive, dusty-blue, teal and charcoal palette. Keep the scout, unsigned proposal and phone in the central crop-safe area. No signed contract, signing pen, team uniform, coach in the room, whistle, celebration, trophy, readable text, logo, watermark, UI, gradient, dithering, blur, photorealism or result-confirming imagery.
